card.name: Measurement units right after a number
card.fires_on: The unit word right after a number, such as line(s), mL, mm, g, or minute. It is most common in clinical measurements and thresholds, and it often comes before a second unit part such as Hg or /dL.

modes.label: Units after a number
modes.description: A unit of measure follows a numeric value in a lab, trial, or pressure statement.
